mainEntity.name: What is the most cost-effective way to query frontier models?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using providers that support prompt caching (Anthropic, DeepSeek) and routing routine sub-tasks to efficient tier models.

mainEntity.name: How does DeepSeek V4 compare in price-to-performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: DeepSeek V4 provides frontier-level coding and reasoning at approximately one-fifth the cost of proprietary western frontier models.

mainEntity.name: Are API aggregator platforms cheaper than direct provider APIs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aggregators like OpenRouter offer competitive rates and easy failover, though direct APIs offer lower latency and native caching.

mainEntity.name: How does prompt caching reduce AI operational expenses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cached system prompts and documentation incur only a fraction of normal input token costs across repeat queries.

mainEntity.name: Can small teams run frontier-grade models locally?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quantized open-weight models (like Llama 4 and DeepSeek distillations) run effectively on high-end consumer hardware.
